response.sql: WITH funding_counts AS (SELECT p.fundflux, COUNT(*) AS qc_count FROM scanqc AS q INNER JOIN projects AS p ON p.arcregistry = q.arcref GROUP BY p.fundflux) SELECT fundflux, qc_count, qc_count::numeric / SUM(qc_count) OVER () AS fraction_of_total, qc_count::numeric / AVG(qc_count::numeric) OVER () AS relative_to_average FROM funding_counts ORDER BY fundflux NULLS LAST;
